body.markdown:
# Product brief: collapsible silicone colander (Amazon ES)

Pinned: rart_report_col_market_01@2, rart_report_col_comp_01@1. No supplier research is retained: target cost, sample cost and supplier choice are unknown.

## 1. Product Overview

Proposed: a 24-26 cm collapsible silicone colander for Amazon Spain. Two direct collapsible offers were observed at 11.99 and 14.50 EUR on 2026-09-02. No launch, supplier or SKU is approved.

## 2. Target Audience

Task-based only: households that drain pasta or vegetables and store the colander flat in a drawer. Audience size is unknown.

## 3. Personas

No demographic evidence is retained; personas stay task-based.

## 4. Problems & Pain Points

No original review body is retained, so no pain point is established; ratings are counts, not themes.

## 5. Competitive Landscape

Direct: B0FAKE0C01 (Plegasa, 24 cm) 11.99 EUR and B0FAKE0C02 (Cocinova, 26 cm) 14.50 EUR, current offers on 2026-09-02, shipping unknown. Alternative: B0FAKE0C04, a rigid plastic colander at 6.49 EUR.

## 6. Differentiation

Proposed: drawer-storage fold height as the lead. Both direct competitors already claim collapsibility, so uniqueness is unproven.

## 7. Objections

Durability, smell and stability objections remain hypotheses without review bodies.

## 8. Switching Dynamics

Actual switching behaviour is unknown.

## 9. Customer Language

No verifiable original review body is retained.

## 10. Brand Voice

No ERP-retained brand rule. The merchant's private naming preference (Casa Verde in Latin letters) is applied as an instruction, not cited as evidence.

## 11. Proof Points

Evidence establishes dated listing identities, prices and per-listing purchase floors only (B0FAKE0C01 at least 200, B0FAKE0C02 at least 500 in the past month, lower bounds for those listings).

## 12. Success Metrics

No approved baseline or target; per-listing floors are lower bounds and cannot serve as a sales target.
